MAHATMA GANDHI INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (Autonomous)
B.Tech. III Semester Supplementary Examinations, July 2025
Computer Organization and Architecture
(Common to CSE, CSB, CSM and CSD)

Time: 3 Hours Answer ALL Questions Max. Marks: 60
Part-A (10x I= 10 Marks)

Define interrupt?

What is the use of load and store memory reference instruction?
Discuss about the term control word?

Differentiate hardwired control and micro-programmed control.
Draw the flow chart for the add and subtract operations.

Write about various decimal arithmetic micro operation symbols.
Define burst transfer.

Define Hit ratio and Miss ratio.

What is Microprocessor?

Explain the advantages of pipelining.

Part-B (5 x 10 = 50 Marks)

Analyse the Basic Operational concepts of Computers.
List and explain the steps involved in the execution of a complete
instruction cycle. List the basic symbols used in register transfer
Language.

OR
Contrast memory reference instructions with respect to register
reference instructions.
Define bus structures. Explain about the bus structures of computers.
Explain Address sequencing in micro programmed control unit?
Illustrate the micro-programmed control unit (MCU) with a neat
diagram and how instructions will be processed in MCU?

OR
Explain different types of addressing modes.
Define an instruction format? Explain different types of instruction
formats in detail.
With a neat Flowchart analyse Floating-Point Addition and
Subtraction.
Explain the hardware implementation for signed magnitude for
addition and subtraction.

OR
Elaborate steps used in Booth algorithm for multiplying following
binary numbers (+15) * (-13).
Demonstrate division algorithm for fixed point numbers with the help
of a flow chart.
What is auxiliary memory? Explain the various memory components
used as auxiliary memory in computer systems.
Explain the following with respect to asynchronous data transfer.
i) Strobe control ii) Handshaking 111) Asynchronous serial transfer.
